profile.headline: Reinforcement Learning | Control | Trajectory Optimization
profile.summary:
I work in learning-enabled control and trajectory planning. I've led funded R&D on RL-based control and planning for autonomous flight systems. I now work on whole-body control for humanoid robots.
 
My technical work spans:

• Reinforcement Learning: sim-to-real transfer via domain randomization, constrained policy optimization, multi-agent coordination (CTDE).
• Control: model predictive, nonlinear and adaptive, optimization-based gain synthesis under margin constraints.
• Trajectory Planning: optimization-based (DDP, interior point, pseudospectral), search-based (MCTS, Hybrid A*), sampling-based (CL-RRT).
 
I work primarily in Python, PyTorch, C++.

positions.title: Principal Member Of Technical Staff
positions.description:
PI / Co-PI on multi-year, internally and externally funded R&D programs for autonomous flight systems.

-  RL for 6-DOF vehicle control, trajectory planning, and multi-agent coordination (PPO, MAPPO) across recurrent, Transformer, and graph network architectures.
- Created end-to-end training pipelines (environments, action/observation design, rewards, curricula, architectures) for learning-enabled control and trajectory planning; methods adopted throughout organization.
- Sim-to-real transfer of recurrent RL control policies trained under domain randomization; validated on-hardware under varied conditions.
- Constrained policy optimization for PPO via an augmented Lagrangian; demonstrated in processor-in-the-loop test.
- Maneuver planning via MCTS, CL-RRT, Hybrid A*, constrained trajectory optimization via numerical optimal control.
- Flight dynamics (3DOF & 6DOF) modeling & multi-agent simulation development

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Control algorithm R&D (nonlinear, adaptive, LQR, MPC) for large power systems

• Designed new nonlinear adaptive control for large natural gas engines -- improving transient / steady-state performance and reducing calibration time.
• Led a multi-year university research collaboration on coordinated MIMO control, time-varying LQR with online Riccati updates for actuator coordination, substantially improving transient surge margin.
• Built dynamic engine models and stochastic combustion simulators; led algorithm transition from simulation through SWIL/HWIL to deployment.
